steps.text: 1. The Tourist picks the author name on the tour details (UC#02).
2. The system (Auth) returns the author's public profile and (Tour) the list of the author's latest public tours. E1, E2.

exceptions.text: E1. The author has no public tours → empty tour list.
E2. Not a Contributor, banned or suspended → 404 "Author not found".

steps.text: 3. The system shows the avatar (or initials when there is no photo), name, bio, join date, follower count and tours. A5.
5. The system updates the button on the screen at once, saves the follow relation and returns the new follower count. E4, E5.

exceptions.text: E3. Invalid profile → 400; the account does not exist → 404.
E4. Following oneself → 400; not signed in → 401.
E5. No network → the follow button is reverted and a connection error is shown.

steps: A5. The author views their own page: an "Edit profile" link is shown instead of the follow button.
A2. Unfollow: the Tourist taps "Following"; the system deletes the follow relation.
A3. A visitor who is not signed in taps "Follow" → goes to the Sign in page.
A1.1. The Contributor opens Account → "Profile", edits the full name (1–120 characters), bio (up to 500 characters) and uploads an avatar.
A1.2. The system uploads the image to Media, saves the profile and reports success. Users who are not Contributors can also edit their profile. E3.
A4. Following list: Account → "Following" (20 items per page).
